scope: Visual inspection of three anonymous live installer screenshots; not a physical-phone installation test.

screenshots.review: English branding, language controls, browser entry, iPhone/Android instructions, QR, Copy link and PDF/PNG/SVG controls remain readable with no overlap or horizontal overflow. Account and pending-Report safety guidance remains visible.
Chinese text has intact glyphs and readable line wrapping. Controls, QR and download labels stay within the phone-width cards without clipping or overlap.
Cold-offline rendering is byte-identical to English online rendering. The complete installer, including logo and QR, remains legible after all previous pages closed.

previewParity: Each live screenshot is byte-identical to the corresponding reviewed preview screenshot.

automatedChecks.installerArtifacts: All seven artifacts match frozen local SHA-256 and MIME types.
automatedChecks.layout: 390px document width in English, Chinese and cold-offline captures.
automatedChecks.isolation: No protected requests, page errors, native prompts or service-worker messages.

limits: Anonymous static-only inspection; no account or Report mutation.
Physical iOS/Android installation, native prompts and camera QR scanning remain unverified.
